description: Official Genasys zone evacuation warnings and orders for the Eaton Fire, Jan 7-8 2025, keyed by our zone ids. One row per (zone, alert). Times are the sent times in the AAR table (minute precision, PST = UTC-8); t_sim_ms is UTC epoch ms.

aar.title: OFFICIAL After-Action Review of Alert Notification Systems and Evacuation Policies for the Eaton and Palisades Fires (McChrystal Group for LA County)
aar.used: Appendix 10 Figure 33 (printed pp.115-117) is the per-zone table; body text pp.25-26

citygate.title: Investigation Report of the Eaton Fire Evacuation Alerts (Citygate)
citygate.used: Tables 1-7 (printed pp.14-44) corroborate every AAR row through 05:01 PST Jan 8 (advisory 18:48 vs 18:49); the report's tables stop at 05:00

aar_synopsis.title: AAR Eaton Fire Synopsis of Findings and Timeline
aar_synopsis.used: 18:48 advisory, 19:26 first orders, 03:25 west-of-Lake orders (no per-zone times)

notes: Advisories ('BE ALERT AND MONITOR') are kept in 'advisories', not 'entries': they are neither warnings nor orders.
AAR Appendix 10 is the per-zone source; Citygate times agree minute-for-minute where both exist, except the advisory (AAR table 18:49, Citygate and AAR text 18:48).
Zone ALD-MENDOCINO: ordered 19:26, then listed again in the AAR's 19:55 warning row (Citygate's 19:55 row omits it), then ordered again 21:00.
Jan 9 Mt. Wilson orders (LAC-E167, LAC-E165-B, LAC-E168-A) are out of scope (not Jan 7-8).
Our zones that appear in no Jan 7-8 official row: ALD-RUBIO, CRV-MONTROSE, PAS-E001, PAS-E002, PAS-E003
